briefing.summary: On stand at Sydney. Delivery has just issued your IFR clearance with a SID.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, cleared to Coffs Harbour via the RIVET TWO departure, climb via SID to flight level one eight zero, squawk five six four three.

challenge.expectedText: Cleared to Coffs Harbour via RIVET TWO departure, climb via SID to flight level one eight zero, squawk five six four three, Mike X-ray Golf.

elements.hint: Name the specific SID — 'departure' alone isn't enough.

elements.label: Climb constraint
accept: climb to flight level one eight zero

challenge.explanation: MATS Part 4: SID readback is a full clearance readback — limit, route (named SID), level/climb constraint, squawk, callsign.
